report: settings save appeared disconnected from the backend
diagnosis: SQL path verified sound: save_settings performs a real UPSERT into the 'app' settings row; row exists, seeded by init_app at first launch

actual UI defect (ours): save_settings returns Ok(()) which reaches JS as null, and the note logic treated null as 'backend unreachable' - a SUCCESSFUL save displayed 'Save failed', making a working backend look disconnected
onboarding save had no verification either
fix: save now VERIFIES BY READ-BACK: after the write, get_settings re-reads the ledger and the UI compares persisted values against what was requested; the note reports read-back truth ('Saved and verified in the local ledger (read-back match)'), never the null-return artifact
onboarding does the same read-back check before declaring success
verification: rebuilt + relaunched (app stable); settings row present; final confirmation is user save -> read-back note -> visible row change
